text:
Emma (People Ops): Heads up — 3pm visitor (Morgan) arriving with a demo crate, a stroller and two toddlers + helium balloons. Badge printer low on ribbon, and the crate has a “tall/please don't tilt” label.
Jake H.: I can swap my hotdesk near the front so they have a quieter corner. Which meeting room is booked?
Maya L.: 3pm is currently booked for Team Retro in MR1, but MR2 is free until 4:30. Can we put the demo there?
Front Desk: Noted. If the crate is tall, we'll need help maneuvering through the double doors — recommend two people.
Samir P.: I can be by 2:50 to help unload. I have a folding dolly in my bike locker.
Olivia R.: Also: Walker stroller, correct? Happy to watch the toddlers for a few minutes while you badge them in.
Emma (People Ops): Thanks! Also flagging package: courier says there will be 2 sealed boxes for Engineering that need signature and can’t be left unattended. They might arrive with the demo.
Courier Bot: Delivery ETA 14:44 — 3 packages: 2 labelled "ENG - SENSITIVE" (sig required), 1 labelled "Morgan - demo crate". Driver will wait up to 10 mins.
Jake H.: I'll be at the lobby 14:40 to meet them. Can someone keep the badge printer ribbon spares near the desk? I think we have a backup roll in the supply closet on the 2nd shelf.
Maya L.: Yep, there's one spare. Ill put a sticky note on it and bring it down @Front Desk.
Front Desk: Printer ribbon moved to lobby cabinet. Also restored badge templates for "visitor (minor)" size.
Emma (People Ops): Cool. Quick reminder: no helium balloons in MR rooms per facilities — they get stuck in the HVAC. Please keep balloons in lobby area.
Samir P.: Good call. Well deflate or anchor them in the lobby.
Olivia R.: If the demo needs power, MR2 has a floor outlet by the long table. If not, bring an extension.
Jake H.: One more thing — the courier requested a photo of the recipient for signature. Is that ok? Company policy allows it for non-sensitive packages.
Emma (People Ops): Fine for the demo crate, but for the "ENG - SENSITIVE" boxes follow signature-only and ask for business card + ID. If driver insists on photos, escalate to security.
Courier Bot: Driver note: will attempt delivery at 14:45; will call contact number on file if no one answers.
Samir P.: Ill bring the dolly and a roll of strong tape just in case the crate needs stabilizing.
Maya L.: Thanks everyone. I'll update the calendar (swap MR1 out) and ping the host team about toddler coverage and balloon rules.
Olivia R.: @Emma (People Ops) — want me to park a "Visitor w/ kids" sign by the lounge couch so nobody sits in the stroller zone?
Emma (People Ops): Please do, that would help. And thank you all for the quick turnaround :heart:
